AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#_uiContainer
		TRAVERSE Toolbar
		REPLACE onSelectionToolModeSelected WITH{

            onSelectionToolModeSelected: (mode) => {
                root.selectionToolMode = mode;
                toolbar.currentSelectionMode = mode;
            }
		}
		END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT




AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
LOCATE BEFORE ALL
INSERT{
property bool currentSelectionMode;
}
END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout > ArkControls.ToolButton[.objectName="hide-show-toolbar-button"]
	
	
	REPLACE  iconSource WITH{
		iconSource:{
							const toolIcons = {
								15: "qrc:/ark/icons/ballpoint_tip",
								17: "qrc:/ark/icons/fineliner_tip",
								18: "qrc:/ark/icons/highlighter_tip", 
								14: "qrc:/ark/icons/pencil_tip",
								13: "qrc:/ark/icons/mechanical_pencil_tip",
								21: "qrc:/ark/icons/calligraphy_pen_tip",
								16: "qrc:/ark/icons/marker_tip",
								23: "qrc:/ark/icons/shader_tip",
								12: "qrc:/ark/icons/paintbrush_tip",
								8: "qrc:/ark/icons/erase_selection",
								6: "qrc:/ark/icons/eraser",
								11: "qrc:/ark/icons/selection_tool"
							};
							if (documentViewTools.activePen.tool == 11 && root.currentSelectionMode == ToolbarModel.SelectionToolMode.Snippet) {return "qrc:/qml/images/icons/capture_tool.svg"}
							return toolIcons[documentViewTools.activePen.tool];
				}
				Text{
							anchors.top:parent.top
							anchors.left:parent.left
							leftPadding: 10
							topPadding: 7
							
							color: "black"
							text: (documentViewTools.activePen.thickness)
						  	visible: documentViewTools.activePen.tool != 8 && documentViewTools.activePen.tool !=11							font.family: "Helvetica"
							font.weight: Font.Bold
							font.pointSize: 15
					}
					Rectangle{
						  	visible: documentViewTools.activePen.tool != 8 && documentViewTools.activePen.tool !=11	
							color: {
								const colorMaps = {
									23: {
										1075912220: "gray",
										1946071552: "orangered",
										2160099282: "magenta",
										1295010528: "deepskyblue",
										1724002610: "red", 
										2157042289: "forestgreen",
										1945823001: "yellow",
										1718932200: "cyan"
									},
									18: {
										4294962549: "yellow",
										4290702078: "deepskyblue", 
										4294090495: "mediumvioletred",
										4294951820: "orangered",
										4289527685: "forestgreen",
										4291282886: "gray"
									}
								};

								const paletteColors = {
									0: "black",
									1: "gray", 
									2: "white",
									6: "blue",
									7: "red",
									10: "limegreen", 
									13: "yellow",
									11: "cyan", 
									12: "magenta"
								};

								if (documentViewTools.activePen.tool === 23 || documentViewTools.activePen.tool === 18) {
									return colorMaps[documentViewTools.activePen.tool][documentViewTools.activePen.colorCode] || "beige";
								}

								return paletteColors[documentViewTools.activePen.color] || "beige";
							}
							anchors.top: parent.top
							anchors.right: parent.right
							width: (parent.width/5)
							height: (parent.height/5)
							antialiasing: false
							radius: width/2
							anchors.topMargin: 10
							anchors.rightMargin: 10
						}
	}
	REMOVE contentItem.rotation
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
